title: Ferric Derisomaltose Injection
overview: Ferric derisomaltose is used to treat iron-deficiency anemia (a lower than normal number of red blood cells due to not enough iron in the body). Ferric derisomaltose is in a class of medications called iron replacement products. It works by providing iron so that the body can make more red blood cells.
